headlines.title: Netflix (NFLX) Replaces Bela Bajaria With Peter Rice As Content Chief
headlines.summary: Netflix (NasdaqGS:NFLX) has replaced chief content officer Bela Bajaria with former Disney and Fox executive Peter Rice. The leadership change coincides with Netflix undertaking its largest workforce reduction to date across global operations. Rice previously oversaw a broad slate of scripted and unscripted hits spanning broadcast TV, cable networks, and streaming platforms. The shakeup that moves content control from Bela Bajaria to Peter Rice is only one piece of the Netflix story.

description: Netflix, Inc. provides entertainment services worldwide. The company offers television (TV) series, documentaries, feature films, games, and live programming across various genres and languages. It also provides members the ability to receive streaming content through a host of internet-connected devices, including TVs, digital video players, TV set-top boxes, and mobile devices. Netflix, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, California.
